summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Brought up and integrated ROS2 robot drivers across state, sensing, and actuation for a 6-DoF UR5e and a voice-controlled robotic arm, resolving 11 cross-boundary integration failures (networking, timing, sensor sync) to reach 100% pick reliability on physical hardware. Experienced tuning real-time actuation and control loops (interrupt-driven UART/I2C/TCP comms, FreeRTOS task coordination) across Jetson, Arduino, and STM32 platforms, with hardware-in-the-loop validation in ROS2 and CARLA.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 cross-boundary integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture, networking/timing drift); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Brought up and integrated the UR ROS 2 driver for collision-free pick-and-place trajectory execution; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM actuation control with interrupt-driven UART command handling and user override on an STM32 target.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Designed and simulated a full ABB RobotStudio workcell for an end-to-end press-to-packing assembly pipeline including CAD-modeled fixtures.
Programmed in RAPID with TCP socket-based pose acquisition and interrupt-driven press-bench logic; validated full-cycle repeatability.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
